questions.prompt: The company adopted more ___ practices to reduce its carbon footprint.
questions.promptVi: Công ty đã áp dụng nhiều biện pháp ___ hơn để giảm lượng khí thải carbon.
questions.explanation: "Sustainable" means able to continue over time without depleting resources.
questions.promptJa: その企業は、炭素排出量を削減するためにより ___ な慣行を採用した。
questions.explanationJa: 「sustainable」は資源を枯渇させることなく長期的に続けられることを意味する。

questions.prompt: Which word means 'to make a problem less severe'?
questions.promptVi: Từ nào có nghĩa là 'làm cho một vấn đề bớt nghiêm trọng hơn'?
questions.explanation: "Alleviate" means to make something less severe.
questions.promptJa: 「問題の深刻さを和らげる」という意味の言葉はどれですか。
questions.explanationJa: 「alleviate」は問題や苦痛などを和らげる、軽減することを意味する。

questions.prompt: Coastal towns must become more ___ to rising sea levels.
questions.promptVi: Các thị trấn ven biển phải trở nên ___ hơn trước mực nước biển dâng.
questions.explanation: "Resilient" describes the ability to withstand or recover from difficulties.
questions.promptJa: 沿岸の町は、海面上昇に対してより ___ にならなければならない。
questions.explanationJa: 「resilient」は困難に耐え、そこから回復する能力を表す。

questions.prompt: Many scientists ___ for stronger climate policies.
questions.promptVi: Nhiều nhà khoa học ___ các chính sách khí hậu mạnh mẽ hơn.
questions.explanation: "Advocate for" means to publicly support something.
questions.promptJa: 多くの科学者が、より強力な気候政策を ___ している。
questions.explanationJa: 「advocate for」は何かを公に支持することを意味する。

questions.prompt: Solar and wind power are examples of ___ energy sources that will not run out.
questions.promptVi: Năng lượng mặt trời và gió là ví dụ về các nguồn năng lượng ___ sẽ không bao giờ cạn kiệt.
questions.explanation: "Renewable" describes energy sources that naturally replenish, such as sun and wind; "volatile" describes something unstable or unpredictable, unrelated to sustainability of a resource.
questions.promptJa: 太陽光や風力は、枯渇することのない ___ エネルギー源の例である。
questions.explanationJa: 「renewable」は太陽や風のように自然に補充されるエネルギー源を意味する。「volatile」は不安定で予測できないことを表し、資源の持続可能性とは関係がない。

questions.prompt: Factories are required to reduce their carbon ___ to comply with new environmental laws.
questions.promptVi: Các nhà máy được yêu cầu giảm ___ carbon để tuân thủ luật môi trường mới.
questions.explanation: "Emission" refers to gases or substances released into the air; "disparity" means an unfair difference between groups, unrelated to pollutants released by factories.
questions.promptJa: 工場は新しい環境法を遵守するために、炭素 ___ を削減することが求められている。
questions.explanationJa: 「emission」は大気中に放出されるガスや物質を意味する。「disparity」は集団間の不公平な差を意味し、工場が排出する汚染物質とは関係がない。

questions.prompt: Factories along the river release harmful ___ that damage aquatic life.
questions.promptVi: Các nhà máy dọc theo dòng sông thải ra các ___ có hại làm tổn hại đến sinh vật dưới nước.
questions.explanation: "Pollutants" are substances that contaminate the environment; "advocates" refers to people who support a cause, an unrelated meaning.
questions.promptJa: 川沿いの工場は、水生生物に害を与える有害な ___ を排出している。
questions.explanationJa: 「pollutants」は環境を汚染する物質を意味する。「advocates」はある主張を支持する人々を指し、無関係な意味である。

questions.prompt: The rainforest's rich ___ includes thousands of unique plant and animal species.
questions.promptVi: ___ phong phú của rừng nhiệt đới bao gồm hàng nghìn loài thực vật và động vật độc đáo.
questions.explanation: "Biodiversity" means the variety of living species in an environment; "legislation" refers to laws, unrelated to describing species variety.
questions.promptJa: 熱帯雨林の豊かな ___ には、何千もの独特な動植物の種が含まれている。
questions.explanationJa: 「biodiversity」はある環境における生物種の多様性を意味する。「legislation」は法律のことで、種の多様性を表す言葉ではない。

questions.prompt: Local communities are working together to ___ the remaining forest before it disappears completely.
questions.promptVi: Các cộng đồng địa phương đang hợp tác để ___ diện tích rừng còn lại trước khi nó biến mất hoàn toàn.
questions.explanation: "Conserve" means to protect and preserve something from loss; "exploit" means to use something (often unfairly) for one's own benefit, which contradicts the idea of protecting the forest.
questions.promptJa: 地域社会は、森林が完全に消える前に残っている森を ___ するために協力している。
questions.explanationJa: 「conserve」は何かを保護し、失われないようにすることを意味する。「exploit」は自分の利益のために(しばしば不当に)利用することを意味し、森を保護するという考えと矛盾する。

questions.prompt: Overfishing has begun to ___ fish populations in many parts of the ocean.
questions.promptVi: Đánh bắt quá mức đã bắt đầu làm ___ số lượng cá ở nhiều nơi trên đại dương.
questions.explanation: "Deplete" means to reduce the amount of something significantly; "conserve" means to protect and preserve, the opposite of reducing a resource through overuse.
questions.promptJa: 乱獲は、海の多くの場所で魚の個体数を ___ し始めている。
questions.explanationJa: 「deplete」は何かの量を大きく減らすことを意味する。「conserve」は保護し維持することを意味し、乱獲によって資源を減らすこととは正反対である。

questions.prompt: The report revealed a significant ___ in income between urban and rural areas.
questions.promptVi: Báo cáo cho thấy sự ___ đáng kể về thu nhập giữa khu vực thành thị và nông thôn.
questions.explanation: "Disparity" means a difference, especially one connected with unfair treatment.
questions.promptJa: その報告書は、都市部と農村部の所得における著しい ___ を明らかにした。
questions.explanationJa: 「disparity」は差、特に不公平な扱いに関連する差を意味する。

questions.prompt: The topic of immigration remains highly ___ in many countries.
questions.promptVi: Chủ đề nhập cư vẫn còn rất ___ ở nhiều quốc gia.
questions.explanation: "Controversial" means causing public disagreement.
questions.promptJa: 移民の話題は、多くの国で依然として非常に ___ である。
questions.explanationJa: 「controversial」は世間の意見の対立を引き起こすことを意味する。

questions.prompt: Rapid urban migration is the ___ seen across many developing nations.
questions.promptVi: Di cư đô thị nhanh chóng là một ___ thấy được ở nhiều quốc gia đang phát triển.
questions.explanation: "Phenomenon" means a fact or situation that is observed to exist.
questions.promptJa: 急速な都市への移住は、多くの発展途上国で見られる ___ である。
questions.explanationJa: 「phenomenon」は存在すると観察される事実や状況を意味する。

questions.prompt: New ___ was passed to protect workers' rights.
questions.promptVi: ___ mới đã được thông qua để bảo vệ quyền lợi của người lao động.
questions.explanation: "Legislation" refers to laws made by a government.
questions.promptJa: 労働者の権利を保護するために新しい ___ が可決された。
questions.explanationJa: 「legislation」は政府によって制定される法律を指す。

questions.prompt: The company was sued for ___ after refusing to hire qualified candidates based on their age.
questions.promptVi: Công ty đã bị kiện vì ___ khi từ chối tuyển dụng các ứng viên đủ điều kiện dựa trên độ tuổi của họ.
questions.explanation: "Discrimination" means unfair treatment of people based on characteristics like age or race; "legislation" refers to laws themselves, not the unfair act of treating people differently.
questions.promptJa: その会社は、年齢を理由に適格な候補者の採用を拒否したとして ___ で訴えられた。
questions.explanationJa: 「discrimination」は年齢や人種などの特徴に基づく不公平な扱いを意味する。「legislation」は法律そのものを指し、人々を差別的に扱う行為ではない。

questions.prompt: The new policy aims to give ___ communities better access to healthcare and education.
questions.promptVi: Chính sách mới nhằm mang lại cho các cộng đồng bị ___ khả năng tiếp cận tốt hơn với y tế và giáo dục.
questions.explanation: "Marginalized" describes groups pushed to the edges of society with limited power or resources; "affluent" means wealthy, essentially the opposite condition.
questions.promptJa: 新しい政策は、___ された地域社会に、より良い医療と教育へのアクセスを提供することを目的としている。
questions.explanationJa: 「marginalized」は社会の中で権力や資源から取り残された集団を意味する。「affluent」は裕福であることを意味し、ほぼ正反対の状態である。

questions.prompt: Economists have long studied the causes of income ___ between social classes.
questions.promptVi: Các nhà kinh tế học đã nghiên cứu từ lâu về nguyên nhân của ___ thu nhập giữa các tầng lớp xã hội.
questions.explanation: "Inequality" means an unfair difference in opportunities or resources; "legislation" refers to laws, which may address inequality but doesn't mean the unfairness itself.
questions.promptJa: 経済学者たちは長い間、社会階層間の所得 ___ の原因を研究してきた。
questions.explanationJa: 「inequality」は機会や資源における不公平な差を意味する。「legislation」は法律のことで、不平等そのものを意味するわけではない。

questions.prompt: The government expanded its ___ programs to support unemployed families.
questions.promptVi: Chính phủ đã mở rộng các chương trình ___ để hỗ trợ các gia đình thất nghiệp.
questions.explanation: "Welfare" refers to government financial or social support for people in need; "phenomenon" means an observed occurrence, unrelated to assistance programs.
questions.promptJa: 政府は失業家庭を支援するために ___ プログラムを拡大した。
questions.explanationJa: 「welfare」は困っている人々への政府の財政的・社会的支援を意味する。「phenomenon」は観察される出来事を意味し、支援プログラムとは関係がない。

questions.prompt: Millions of people around the world still live in extreme ___, lacking basic necessities.
questions.promptVi: Hàng triệu người trên thế giới vẫn sống trong cảnh ___ cùng cực, thiếu những nhu cầu thiết yếu.
questions.explanation: "Poverty" means the state of being extremely poor; "luxury" means great comfort and wealth, the direct opposite of lacking basic necessities.
questions.promptJa: 世界中で何百万人もの人々が、基本的な必需品にも事欠く極度の ___ の中で暮らしている。
questions.explanationJa: 「poverty」は極度に貧しい状態を意味する。「luxury」は贅沢さや裕福さを意味し、必需品が欠けている状態とは正反対である。

questions.prompt: Marketers study ___ data like age and income to understand their target customers.
questions.promptVi: Các nhà tiếp thị nghiên cứu dữ liệu ___ như độ tuổi và thu nhập để hiểu khách hàng mục tiêu của họ.
questions.explanation: "Demographic" relates to statistical data about a population, such as age or income; "cognitive" relates to mental processes, unrelated to population statistics.
questions.promptJa: マーケティング担当者は、対象となる顧客を理解するために年齢や所得などの ___ データを調べる。
questions.explanationJa: 「demographic」は年齢や所得など、人口に関する統計データに関連する。「cognitive」は思考など精神的な過程に関連し、人口統計とは関係がない。

questions.prompt: Mobile payment apps have become ___ in urban areas.
questions.promptVi: Các ứng dụng thanh toán di động đã trở nên ___ ở khu vực thành thị.
questions.explanation: "Ubiquitous" means present or found everywhere.
questions.promptJa: モバイル決済アプリは都市部で ___ になった。
questions.explanationJa: 「ubiquitous」はどこにでも存在する、あるいは見られることを意味する。

questions.prompt: The startup is praised for its ___ approach to solving old problems.
questions.promptVi: Công ty khởi nghiệp được khen ngợi vì cách tiếp cận ___ trong việc giải quyết các vấn đề cũ.
questions.explanation: "Innovative" means introducing new ideas or methods.
questions.promptJa: そのスタートアップは、古い問題を解決するための ___ なアプローチで称賛されている。
questions.explanationJa: 「innovative」は新しい考えや方法を導入することを意味する。

questions.prompt: Too much unregulated social media use can be ___ to mental health.
questions.promptVi: Sử dụng mạng xã hội quá mức và không kiểm soát có thể ___ đến sức khỏe tinh thần.
questions.explanation: "Detrimental" means causing harm or damage.
questions.promptJa: 無規制なソーシャルメディアの使いすぎは、精神的健康に ___ な影響を及ぼす可能性がある。
questions.explanationJa: 「detrimental」は害や損害を引き起こすことを意味する。

questions.prompt: Factory ___ has replaced many repetitive manual jobs with machines.
questions.promptVi: ___ hóa nhà máy đã thay thế nhiều công việc thủ công lặp đi lặp lại bằng máy móc.
questions.explanation: "Automation" means the use of machines to perform tasks without human labor; "disparity" means an unfair difference, unrelated to machines replacing jobs.
questions.promptJa: 工場の ___ 化は、多くの繰り返し作業を機械に置き換えた。
questions.explanationJa: 「automation」は人手を使わずに機械で作業を行うことを意味する。「disparity」は不公平な差を意味し、機械が仕事を代替することとは関係がない。

questions.prompt: The app uses a complex ___ to recommend videos based on what you've watched before.
questions.promptVi: Ứng dụng sử dụng một ___ phức tạp để đề xuất video dựa trên những gì bạn đã xem trước đó.
questions.explanation: "Algorithm" means a set of rules or steps a computer follows to perform a task; "curriculum" refers to educational subjects taught in school, an unrelated concept.
questions.promptJa: そのアプリは、以前見た内容に基づいて動画を勧めるために複雑な ___ を使用している。
questions.explanationJa: 「algorithm」はコンピューターがタスクを実行するために従う一連の規則や手順を意味する。「curriculum」は学校で教えられる教科のことで、無関係な概念である。

questions.prompt: Old flip phones quickly became ___ once smartphones entered the market.
questions.promptVi: Điện thoại nắp gập cũ nhanh chóng trở nên ___ khi điện thoại thông minh xuất hiện trên thị trường.
questions.explanation: "Obsolete" means no longer used because something newer has replaced it; "resilient" means able to recover from difficulty, unrelated to being outdated technology.
questions.promptJa: スマートフォンが市場に登場すると、古い折り畳み式携帯電話はすぐに ___ になった。
questions.explanationJa: 「obsolete」は新しいものに取って代わられ、もはや使われなくなることを意味する。「resilient」は困難から立ち直る能力を意味し、時代遅れの技術とは関係がない。

questions.prompt: Scientists announced a major ___ in cancer treatment after years of research.
questions.promptVi: Các nhà khoa học đã công bố một ___ lớn trong điều trị ung thư sau nhiều năm nghiên cứu.
questions.explanation: "Breakthrough" means a significant discovery or advance after effort; "malfunction" means a failure to work properly, the opposite of a successful advance.
questions.promptJa: 科学者たちは何年もの研究の末、がん治療における大きな ___ を発表した。
questions.explanationJa: 「breakthrough」は努力の末に得られる重要な発見や進歩を意味する。「malfunction」は正常に機能しない故障のことで、成功した進歩とは正反対である。

questions.prompt: The self-driving car had to stop suddenly due to a sensor ___.
questions.promptVi: Chiếc xe tự lái phải dừng đột ngột do một ___ của cảm biến.
questions.explanation: "Malfunction" means a failure to work correctly; "breakthrough" refers to a positive advance, the opposite of a device failing.
questions.promptJa: 自動運転車は、センサーの ___ により急に停止しなければならなかった。
questions.explanationJa: 「malfunction」は正常に作動しない故障を意味する。「breakthrough」は肯定的な進歩を指し、装置の故障とは正反対である。

questions.prompt: The bank invested heavily in ___ to protect customer data from hackers.
questions.promptVi: Ngân hàng đã đầu tư mạnh vào ___ để bảo vệ dữ liệu khách hàng khỏi tin tặc.
questions.explanation: "Cybersecurity" refers to protecting computer systems from digital attacks; "disparity" means an unfair difference, unrelated to protecting data.
questions.promptJa: 銀行は、顧客データをハッカーから守るために ___ に多額の投資を行った。
questions.explanationJa: 「cybersecurity」はコンピューターシステムをデジタル攻撃から守ることを意味する。「disparity」は不公平な差を意味し、データ保護とは関係がない。

questions.prompt: Messaging apps ___ conversations so that only the sender and receiver can read them.
questions.promptVi: Các ứng dụng nhắn tin ___ các cuộc trò chuyện để chỉ người gửi và người nhận mới có thể đọc được.
questions.explanation: "Encrypt" means to convert information into a coded form to prevent unauthorized access; "publish" means to make something available for anyone to read, the opposite of restricting access to only the sender and receiver.
questions.promptJa: メッセージアプリは、送信者と受信者だけが読めるように会話を ___ する。
questions.explanationJa: 「encrypt」は不正アクセスを防ぐために情報を暗号化することを意味する。「publish」は誰でも読めるように公開することを意味し、送信者と受信者だけが読めるようにすることとは正反対である。

questions.prompt: ___ rates among children have increased due to poor diet.
questions.promptVi: Tỷ lệ ___ ở trẻ em đã tăng lên do chế độ ăn uống kém.
questions.explanation: "Obesity" is the condition of being extremely overweight.
questions.promptJa: 食生活の悪化により、子どもの ___ 率が増加している。
questions.explanationJa: 「obesity」は体重が極端に多すぎる状態、つまり肥満を意味する。

questions.prompt: A ___ diet combined with exercise supports long-term health.
questions.promptVi: Một chế độ ăn ___ kết hợp với tập thể dục hỗ trợ sức khỏe lâu dài.
questions.explanation: "Sustainable" here means a habit that can be maintained long-term.
questions.promptJa: 運動と組み合わせた ___ な食生活は、長期的な健康を支える。
questions.explanationJa: ここでの「sustainable」は、長期的に続けられる習慣を意味する。

questions.prompt: Doctors should be ___ when reviewing patient symptoms.
questions.promptVi: Bác sĩ nên ___ khi xem xét triệu chứng của bệnh nhân.
questions.explanation: "Meticulous" means showing great attention to detail.
questions.promptJa: 医師は患者の症状を確認する際、___ であるべきだ。
questions.explanationJa: 「meticulous」は細部に至るまで注意を払うことを意味する。

questions.prompt: Her body felt very hot, so the doctor said she had a ___.
questions.promptVi: Cơ thể cô ấy rất nóng, nên bác sĩ nói cô ấy bị ___.
questions.explanation: "Fever" means having a body temperature higher than normal, often caused by illness; "headache" describes pain in the head, a different symptom from a raised temperature.
questions.promptJa: 彼女の体はとても熱かったので、医師は彼女が ___ だと言った。
questions.explanationJa: 「fever」は病気などによって体温が通常より高くなることを意味する。「headache」は頭の痛みを表し、体温が上がることとは違う症状である。

questions.prompt: Smoking for many years can give you a serious ___.
questions.promptVi: Hút thuốc nhiều năm có thể khiến bạn bị ___ nặng.
questions.explanation: "Cough" is a repeated reflex to clear your throat or lungs, often caused by smoking; "fever" means a raised body temperature, a different symptom caused by illness, not smoking.
questions.promptJa: 長年タバコを吸うと、ひどい ___ が出ることがある。
questions.explanationJa: 「cough」は喉や肺をきれいにしようとする反射的な動作の繰り返しで、喫煙が原因になることがある。「fever」は体温が上がることを意味し、喫煙ではなく病気によって起こる別の症状である。

questions.prompt: The pharmacist gave him the right ___ for his cold.
questions.promptVi: Dược sĩ đã đưa cho anh ấy đúng loại ___ cho cơn cảm lạnh.
questions.explanation: "Medicine" refers to a drug or treatment used to cure an illness; "bandage" is a strip of material used to cover a wound, not something you swallow for a cold.
questions.promptJa: 薬剤師は彼に風邪のための正しい ___ を渡した。
questions.explanationJa: 「medicine」は病気を治すための薬や治療を意味する。「bandage」は傷を覆うための布のことであり、風邪のために飲むものではない。

questions.prompt: I need to make an ___ to see the dentist next week.
questions.promptVi: Tôi cần đặt một ___ để khám nha sĩ vào tuần tới.
questions.explanation: "Appointment" is an arranged time to meet someone, such as a dentist; "examination" refers to a medical check itself, not the arranged meeting time.
questions.promptJa: 来週歯医者に行くために ___ を取る必要がある。
questions.explanationJa: 「appointment」は歯医者などと会うために取り決めた時間のことである。「examination」は診察そのものを指し、取り決めた時間ではない。

questions.prompt: Even when you feel fine, you should visit the doctor for a regular ___.
questions.promptVi: Ngay cả khi bạn cảm thấy khỏe, bạn cũng nên đến bác sĩ để ___ định kỳ.
questions.explanation: "Checkup" is a routine visit to make sure you are healthy, even without symptoms; "prescription" is a doctor's written order for medicine, not the visit itself.
questions.promptJa: たとえ体調が良くても、定期的な ___ のために医師の元を訪れるべきである。
questions.explanationJa: 「checkup」は症状がなくても健康を確認するための定期的な受診である。「prescription」は医師が薬について出す指示書のことであり、受診そのものではない。

questions.prompt: After touching the plant, his skin broke out in an itchy ___.
questions.promptVi: Sau khi chạm vào cây, da anh ấy bị nổi một ___ ngứa.
questions.explanation: "Rash" is an area of red, itchy skin often caused by touching something irritating; "infection" is caused by germs entering the body, not simply touching a plant.
questions.promptJa: その植物に触れた後、彼の肌にかゆい ___ ができた。
questions.explanationJa: 「rash」は刺激物に触れることなどが原因で起こる、赤くかゆい肌の状態である。「infection」は細菌などが体に入ることで起こるものであり、植物に触れただけでは起こらない。

questions.prompt: Some people cannot eat peanuts because of an ___ that makes them very sick.
questions.promptVi: Một số người không thể ăn đậu phộng vì họ bị ___ khiến cơ thể rất khó chịu.
questions.explanation: "Allergy" is the body's harmful reaction to a substance like peanuts; "infection" is caused by germs, not by eating a particular food.
questions.promptJa: ひどい体調不良を起こす ___ があるため、ピーナッツを食べられない人もいる。
questions.explanationJa: 「allergy」はピーナッツのような物質に対する体の有害な反応である。「infection」は細菌などによって起こるものであり、特定の食べ物を食べることによるものではない。

questions.prompt: Schools are redesigning the ___ to include more critical thinking skills.
questions.promptVi: Các trường học đang thiết kế lại ___ để bao gồm nhiều kỹ năng tư duy phản biện hơn.
questions.explanation: "Curriculum" is the subjects and content taught in a school or course.
questions.promptJa: 学校は、より多くの批判的思考力を含めるために ___ を再設計している。
questions.explanationJa: 「curriculum」は学校やコースで教えられる科目や内容を意味する。

questions.prompt: Early childhood education strongly influences ___ development.
questions.promptVi: Giáo dục mầm non ảnh hưởng mạnh mẽ đến sự phát triển ___.
questions.explanation: "Cognitive" relates to mental processes like thinking and learning.
questions.promptJa: 幼児教育は ___ な発達に強い影響を与える。
questions.explanationJa: 「cognitive」は思考や学習といった心的プロセスに関連する。

questions.prompt: Some argue that standardized testing is ___ given how varied student needs are.
questions.promptVi: Một số người cho rằng kiểm tra chuẩn hóa là ___ vì nhu cầu học sinh rất đa dạng.
questions.explanation: "Controversial" fits because the practice causes public disagreement.
questions.promptJa: 生徒のニーズが非常に多様であることを踏まえると、標準テストは ___ だと主張する人もいる。
questions.explanationJa: この慣行は世間で意見の対立を引き起こすため、「controversial」が当てはまる。

questions.prompt: Although many teachers still rely on direct instruction, some school districts now encourage project-based ___ that lets students learn through hands-on investigation.
questions.promptVi: Mặc dù nhiều giáo viên vẫn dựa vào phương pháp giảng dạy trực tiếp, một số sở giáo dục hiện khuyến khích ___ lấy dự án làm trung tâm, giúp học sinh học qua trải nghiệm thực hành.
questions.explanation: "Pedagogy" refers to the methods and practice of teaching; "enrollment" refers to the number of students registered in a course, not the teaching approach itself.
questions.promptJa: 多くの教師が依然として直接指導に頼っている一方で、一部の学区は、生徒が実践的な調査を通して学べるよう、プロジェクトベースの ___ を奨励するようになっている。
questions.explanationJa: 「pedagogy」は教える方法や実践を意味する。「enrollment」はコースに登録している学生数を指し、指導方法そのものではない。

questions.prompt: Because she copied several paragraphs from an online article without citation, the professor accused her of ___ and failed the entire assignment.
questions.promptVi: Vì cô ấy đã sao chép nhiều đoạn văn từ một bài báo trực tuyến mà không trích dẫn nguồn, vị giáo sư đã buộc tội cô ấy ___ và cho cô ấy điểm trượt toàn bộ bài tập.
questions.explanation: "Plagiarism" means presenting someone else's work or ideas as your own without proper credit; "fraud" typically involves deception for financial or personal gain, which does not precisely describe copying text without citation.
questions.promptJa: 彼女はオンライン記事から引用なしに複数の段落をコピーしたため、教授は彼女を ___ で告発し、課題全体を不合格にした。
questions.explanationJa: 「plagiarism」は他人の著作やアイデアを適切な出典表示なしに自分のものとして提示することを意味する。「fraud」は通常、金銭的または個人的な利益を得るための欺瞞を伴い、引用なしに文章をコピーする行為を正確には表さない。

questions.prompt: Since the new online college had not yet received official ___ from the national education board, many employers were reluctant to recognize degrees it awarded.
questions.promptVi: Vì trường đại học trực tuyến mới này chưa nhận được ___ chính thức từ hội đồng giáo dục quốc gia, nhiều nhà tuyển dụng vẫn ngần ngại công nhận các tấm bằng mà trường cấp.
questions.explanation: "Accreditation" refers to the formal recognition that an institution meets quality standards, which is what makes its degrees valid in the eyes of employers; "tenure" refers to permanent job security granted to an individual faculty member, not to an institution's overall approval status, and mere "feedback" would not by itself explain why employers doubted the validity of its degrees.
questions.promptJa: その新しいオンライン大学はまだ国の教育委員会から正式な ___ を受けていなかったため、多くの雇用主はその大学が授与する学位を認めることに消極的だった。
questions.explanationJa: 「accreditation」は教育機関が定められた品質基準を満たしていることを公式に認めることを意味し、それが雇用主にとって学位を有効とみなす根拠となる。「tenure」は大学教員個人に与えられる終身在職権を指し、機関全体の承認状態ではなく、単なる「feedback」だけでは雇用主が学位の有効性を疑った理由を説明できない。

questions.prompt: Before she could enroll in the advanced seminar, the admissions committee required proof of her English ___, since all readings and discussions would be conducted entirely in that language.
questions.promptVi: Trước khi có thể đăng ký khóa semina nâng cao, hội đồng tuyển sinh yêu cầu bằng chứng về ___ tiếng Anh của cô ấy, vì mọi tài liệu đọc và thảo luận đều được tiến hành hoàn toàn bằng ngôn ngữ đó.
questions.explanation: "Proficiency" means a high level of skill or competence in something, here a required standard of English for academic study; "literacy" specifically refers to the basic ability to read and write, not the broader competence needed for advanced seminar discussions.
questions.promptJa: すべての読書課題と討論がその言語で行われるため、彼女が上級ゼミに登録する前に、入学審査委員会は彼女の英語の ___ の証明を求めた。
questions.explanationJa: 「proficiency」は、ここでは上級ゼミでの学習に求められる英語の高い熟達度・運用能力を意味する。「literacy」は読み書きの基本的な能力を特に指し、上級セミナーでの議論に必要なより広い運用能力ではない。

questions.prompt: Although he had already passed all his coursework, the doctoral candidate still needed to defend his ___ in front of a panel of senior professors before graduating.
questions.promptVi: Mặc dù đã hoàn thành tất cả các môn học, nghiên cứu sinh tiến sĩ vẫn phải bảo vệ ___ của mình trước hội đồng gồm các giáo sư cao cấp trước khi tốt nghiệp.
questions.explanation: "Dissertation" is the long research paper a doctoral candidate must complete and formally defend to earn a degree; "manuscript" refers to any draft written document, which is not the specific text defended in a degree examination.
questions.promptJa: 彼はすでにすべての授業科目に合格していたが、博士候補として卒業する前に、上級教授陣から成る審査委員会の前で自分の ___ を弁護する必要があった。
questions.explanationJa: 「dissertation」は博士候補が学位を取得するために完成させ、正式に審査で弁護しなければならない長い研究論文を意味する。「manuscript」は出版前の草稿文書全般を指し、学位審査で弁護される特定の論文ではない。

questions.prompt: Because first-year graduate students often struggle to navigate research expectations alone, the department pairs each one with a senior scholar who provides ongoing ___ throughout the program.
questions.promptVi: Vì sinh viên cao học năm nhất thường gặp khó khăn khi tự mình định hướng các kỳ vọng nghiên cứu, khoa đã ghép mỗi em với một học giả cao cấp, người cung cấp sự ___ liên tục trong suốt chương trình học.
questions.explanation: "Mentorship" refers to ongoing guidance, encouragement, and support offered by an experienced person; "networking" refers to building professional contacts and relationships, not the structured developmental support a senior scholar provides to a student over time.
questions.promptJa: 一年目の大学院生は研究に関する期待を一人で乗り越えるのに苦労することが多いため、学部は各学生を上級研究者と組ませ、プログラムを通して継続的な ___ を提供している。
questions.explanationJa: 「mentorship」は経験豊かな人物による継続的な指導・励まし・支援を意味する。「networking」は人脈づくりや人間関係の構築を指し、ここで述べられているような上級研究者から学生への継続的な育成支援ではない。

questions.prompt: Even though he had never taken a chemistry class before, the placement exam revealed such strong natural ___ for the subject that he was moved into the advanced track.
questions.promptVi: Mặc dù trước đây anh ấy chưa từng học một lớp hóa học nào, bài kiểm tra xếp lớp cho thấy anh có ___ tự nhiên mạnh mẽ đối với môn học này đến mức anh được chuyển thẳng vào lớp nâng cao.
questions.explanation: "Aptitude" means a natural ability or talent for learning or doing something, demonstrated here by strong test performance; "curiosity" describes an eager interest in learning, which does not by itself explain being placed into an advanced track based on measured skill.
questions.promptJa: 彼は以前に化学の授業を受けたことがなかったにもかかわらず、プレースメントテストでその科目に対する強い生来の ___ を示したため、上級クラスへ編入された。
questions.explanationJa: 「aptitude」は、ここでは試験の高い成績によって示される、学んだり行うことに対する生まれ持った能力・才能を意味する。「curiosity」は学ぶことへの強い関心を表すが、それだけでは測定された技能に基づいて上級クラスに編入されたことを説明できない。

questions.prompt: After working a double shift, Tom felt completely ___ and fell asleep on the couch.
questions.promptVi: Sau khi làm việc hai ca liên tiếp, Tom cảm thấy hoàn toàn ___ và ngủ thiếp đi trên ghế sofa.
questions.explanation: "Exhausted" means extremely tired, which fits after a long double shift; "refreshed" would wrongly suggest he felt energized, the opposite meaning.
questions.promptJa: ダブルシフトで働いた後、トムは完全に ___ 状態になり、ソファで眠ってしまった。
questions.explanationJa: 「exhausted」は非常に疲れているという意味で、長時間のダブルシフトの後にぴったり合う。「refreshed」だと逆に元気になったという意味になってしまい、文脈に合わない。

questions.prompt: Which word describes someone who always arrives or does things at the correct time?
questions.promptVi: Từ nào mô tả một người luôn đến hoặc làm việc đúng giờ?
questions.explanation: "Punctual" specifically means being on time; "hurry" describes rushing, which is different from being consistently on time.
questions.promptJa: 常に正しい時間に到着したり物事を行ったりする人を表す言葉はどれですか。
questions.explanationJa: 「punctual」は時間を守ることを意味する。「hurry」は急ぐことを表し、常に時間を守ることとは異なる。

questions.prompt: Getting up at 6 a.m. and jogging is part of her morning ___.
questions.promptVi: Thức dậy lúc 6 giờ sáng và chạy bộ là một phần trong ___ buổi sáng của cô ấy.
questions.explanation: "Routine" refers to a regular sequence of actions; "hurry" describes speed, not a repeated habit, so it doesn't fit here.
questions.promptJa: 朝6時に起きてジョギングをすることは、彼女の朝の ___ の一部だ。
questions.explanationJa: 「routine」は決まった一連の行動を指す。「hurry」は急ぐことを表す言葉であり、繰り返される習慣ではないため、ここには合わない。

questions.prompt: We need to ___ or we'll miss the last bus home.
questions.promptVi: Chúng ta cần phải ___ nếu không sẽ lỡ chuyến xe buýt cuối cùng về nhà.
questions.explanation: "Hurry" means to move or act quickly, matching the urgency of not missing the bus; "punctual" describes being on time as a habit, not the act of rushing right now.
questions.promptJa: 私たちは ___ 必要がある。そうしないと最終バスに乗り遅れてしまう。
questions.explanationJa: 「hurry」は急いで動く、行動するという意味で、バスに乗り遅れないようにする緊急性に合う。「punctual」は習慣として時間を守ることを表し、今まさに急ぐ行為とは異なる。

questions.prompt: After a good night's sleep, I woke up feeling ___ and ready for the day.
questions.promptVi: Sau một giấc ngủ ngon, tôi thức dậy cảm thấy ___ và sẵn sàng cho ngày mới.
questions.explanation: "Refreshed" describes feeling energized after rest; "exhausted" means the opposite (very tired), contradicting the idea of a good night's sleep.
questions.promptJa: ぐっすり眠った後、私は ___ と感じて目覚め、一日を迎える準備ができていた。
questions.explanationJa: 「refreshed」は休息後に元気を感じることを表す。「exhausted」は逆にとても疲れているという意味なので、ぐっすり眠ったという文脈と矛盾する。

questions.prompt: Every morning, the loud sound of my ___ wakes me up at six.
questions.promptVi: Mỗi sáng, tiếng ___ của tôi đánh thức tôi dậy lúc sáu giờ.
questions.explanation: "Alarm clock" is a device that makes a sound to wake you up at a set time; "doorbell" is rung by a visitor at the door, not a device that wakes you up each morning.
questions.promptJa: 毎朝6時に ___ の大きな音で目が覚める。
questions.explanationJa: 「alarm clock」は設定した時刻に音を鳴らして人を起こす機器である。「doorbell」は訪問者がドアで鳴らすものであり、毎朝人を起こす機器ではない。

questions.prompt: Washing the dishes is a boring ___ that I do every evening.
questions.promptVi: Rửa bát là một ___ nhàm chán mà tôi làm mỗi tối.
questions.explanation: "Chore" is a small routine task like washing dishes or cleaning; "puzzle" is a game that challenges your mind, not a repeated household task.
questions.promptJa: 皿洗いは毎晩する退屈な ___ である。
questions.explanationJa: 「chore」は皿洗いや掃除のような日常の小さな仕事のことである。「puzzle」は頭を使う遊びであり、繰り返される家事ではない。

questions.prompt: Her daily ___ to the office takes about forty minutes by train.
questions.promptVi: Việc ___ hằng ngày của cô ấy đến văn phòng mất khoảng bốn mươi phút bằng tàu.
questions.explanation: "Commute" is the regular journey you make to and from work; "chore" is a small task done at home, not a daily trip to work.
questions.promptJa: 彼女の毎日の ___ はオフィスまで電車でおよそ40分かかる。
questions.explanationJa: 「commute」は仕事へ行き来するために毎日する移動のことである。「chore」は家でする小さな仕事であり、仕事への移動ではない。

questions.prompt: After lunch, I usually take a short ___ before going back to work.
questions.promptVi: Sau bữa trưa, tôi thường dành ra một ___ ngắn trước khi quay lại làm việc.
questions.explanation: "Nap" is a short period of sleep during the day; "errand" is a short task like buying something, not a period of sleep.
questions.promptJa: 昼食後、私はたいてい仕事に戻る前に短い ___ をとる。
questions.explanationJa: 「nap」は日中にとる短い睡眠のことである。「errand」は買い物のような短い用事であり、睡眠の時間ではない。

questions.prompt: Every morning, she eats a quick ___, her first meal, before school.
questions.promptVi: Mỗi sáng, cô ấy ăn một ___ nhanh, bữa ăn đầu tiên, trước khi đến trường.
questions.explanation: "Breakfast" is the main meal eaten first thing in the morning before starting the day; "snack" can also be quick, but it is small food eaten between meals, not the first proper meal of the day.
questions.promptJa: 毎朝、彼女は学校に行く前に、その日最初の食事となる手早い ___ を食べる。
questions.explanationJa: 「breakfast」は一日を始める前に朝一番に食べる主な食事のことである。「snack」も手早く食べられるが、食事の間に食べる軽い食べ物であり、一日最初のきちんとした食事ではない。

questions.prompt: The cake she baked was absolutely ___; everyone asked for a second slice.
questions.promptVi: Chiếc bánh cô ấy nướng thật sự rất ___; ai cũng xin thêm một miếng nữa.
questions.explanation: "Delicious" means having a very pleasant taste; "tasteless" means having little or no flavor, the opposite of what's described, and "burnt" means cooked for too long until blackened, which doesn't match a cake everyone asked for more of.
questions.promptJa: 彼女が焼いたケーキは本当に ___ で、みんながもう一切れ欲しがった。
questions.explanationJa: 「delicious」はとても美味しいという意味。「tasteless」は味がほとんどないという意味で正反対であり、「burnt」は焦げているという意味で、みんなが欲しがる様子とは合わない。

questions.prompt: Which word means a set of instructions for preparing a dish?
questions.promptVi: Từ nào có nghĩa là một tập hợp hướng dẫn để chế biến một món ăn?
questions.explanation: "Recipe" is a set of instructions for cooking a dish; "appetite" refers to a desire to eat, not instructions.
questions.promptJa: 料理を作るための一連の手順を意味する言葉はどれですか。
questions.explanationJa: 「recipe」は料理を作るための手順のことである。「appetite」は食べたいという欲求を指し、手順ではない。

questions.prompt: Instead of throwing away the extra rice, we saved the ___ for lunch tomorrow.
questions.promptVi: Thay vì đổ bỏ phần cơm dư, chúng tôi để dành ___ cho bữa trưa hôm sau.
questions.explanation: "Leftovers" are food remaining after a meal; "recipe" refers to cooking instructions, which doesn't make sense as something you save to eat.
questions.promptJa: 余ったご飯を捨てる代わりに、私たちは ___ を翌日の昼食のために取っておいた。
questions.explanationJa: 「leftovers」は食事の後に残った食べ物を意味する。「recipe」は調理手順を指し、食べるために取っておくものとしては意味が通らない。

questions.prompt: After the long hike, he had a huge ___ and ate two full plates.
questions.promptVi: Sau chuyến đi bộ đường dài, anh ấy có một ___ rất lớn và ăn hết hai đĩa đầy.
questions.explanation: "Appetite" means a desire for food; "spicy" describes a taste, not a feeling of hunger, so it doesn't fit.
questions.promptJa: 長いハイキングの後、彼はとても ___ を持ち、大盛りの皿を2枚も平らげた。
questions.explanationJa: 「appetite」は食欲、食べたいという欲求を意味する。「spicy」は味を表す言葉であり、空腹感ではないため合わない。

questions.prompt: The curry was too ___ for the children, so we ordered a milder dish.
questions.promptVi: Món cà ri quá ___ đối với trẻ em, nên chúng tôi đã gọi một món nhạt hơn.
questions.explanation: "Spicy" describes hot-tasting food; "delicious" simply means tasty and doesn't explain why the dish was unsuitable for children.
questions.promptJa: そのカレーは子供たちには ___ すぎたので、私たちはもっとマイルドな料理を注文した。
questions.explanationJa: 「spicy」は辛い味を表す。「delicious」は単に美味しいという意味で、子供に合わなかった理由を説明できない。

questions.prompt: At the restaurant, we asked the ___ to bring more water.
questions.promptVi: Tại nhà hàng, chúng tôi nhờ ___ mang thêm nước.
questions.explanation: "Waiter" is the person who serves food and drinks at a restaurant; "recipe" is a set of cooking instructions, not a person who serves customers.
questions.promptJa: レストランで、私たちは ___ に水をもっと持ってきてもらうよう頼んだ。
questions.explanationJa: 「waiter」はレストランで食べ物や飲み物を提供する人のことである。「recipe」は料理の手順のことであり、客に対応する人ではない。

questions.prompt: Before ordering, she looked at the ___ to choose a dish.
questions.promptVi: Trước khi gọi món, cô ấy xem ___ để chọn một món ăn.
questions.explanation: "Menu" is the list of dishes a restaurant offers; "napkin" is a cloth or paper used to wipe your mouth, not a list of food choices.
questions.promptJa: 注文する前に、彼女は料理を選ぶために ___ を見た。
questions.explanationJa: 「menu」はレストランが提供する料理の一覧のことである。「napkin」は口を拭くための布や紙であり、料理の一覧ではない。

questions.prompt: We made a ___ for eight o'clock at our favorite restaurant.
questions.promptVi: Chúng tôi đã đặt một ___ lúc tám giờ tại nhà hàng yêu thích.
questions.explanation: "Reservation" is a booking that holds a table for you in advance; "chef" is the person who cooks the food, not a booking for a table.
questions.promptJa: 私たちはお気に入りのレストランで8時に ___ をした。
questions.explanationJa: 「reservation」は事前にテーブルを確保しておく予約のことである。「chef」は料理を作る人のことであり、テーブルの予約ではない。

questions.prompt: After the meal, he asked the waiter for the ___ so he could pay.
questions.promptVi: Sau bữa ăn, anh ấy nhờ người phục vụ mang ___ đến để thanh toán.
questions.explanation: "Bill" is the paper showing the amount he must pay, which is what he needs to settle up; "menu" lists the dishes on offer and would not help him pay, even though it is also something ordered from the waiter.
questions.promptJa: 食事の後、彼は支払いをするためにウェイターに ___ を頼んだ。
questions.explanationJa: 「bill」は彼が支払うべき金額を示す紙であり、会計を済ませるために必要なものである。「menu」は料理の一覧のことで、ウェイターに頼むものではあるが支払いの役には立たない。

questions.prompt: At the end of the meal, the ___ was chocolate cake and ice cream.
questions.promptVi: Vào cuối bữa ăn, ___ là bánh sô-cô-la và kem.
questions.explanation: "Dessert" is the sweet course eaten at the end of a meal, matching the description here; "tip" is money given to staff and "bill" is the payment slip, neither of which can be a food, and "appetizer" is served before the main meal, not at the end.
questions.promptJa: 食事の最後に、___ はチョコレートケーキとアイスクリームだった。
questions.explanationJa: 「dessert」は食事の最後に食べる甘い料理であり、この説明と一致する。「tip」はスタッフに渡すお金、「bill」は支払いの伝票であり、どちらも食べ物ではない。「appetizer」は主菜の前に出される料理であり、食事の最後のものではない。

questions.prompt: My older ___ taught me how to ride a bicycle when I was five.
questions.promptVi: ___ lớn của tôi đã dạy tôi đi xe đạp khi tôi lên năm.
questions.explanation: "Sibling" means a brother or sister; "reunion" refers to a gathering, which doesn't fit as the person who taught the skill.
questions.promptJa: 私の年上の ___ が、私が5歳のときに自転車の乗り方を教えてくれた。
questions.explanationJa: 「sibling」は兄弟姉妹を意味する。「reunion」は集まりを表し、自転車の乗り方を教えた人物としては合わない。

questions.prompt: Which word means a gathering of family members who haven't met in years?
questions.promptVi: Từ nào có nghĩa là buổi gặp mặt của các thành viên gia đình lâu không gặp nhau?
questions.explanation: "Reunion" means a gathering of people who have been apart; "supportive" describes an attitude of encouragement, not an event.
questions.promptJa: 何年も会っていない家族の集まりを意味する言葉はどれですか。
questions.explanationJa: 「reunion」は離れていた人々が集まることを意味する。「supportive」は励ますような態度を表し、出来事ではない。

questions.prompt: Her parents have always been ___ of her decision to study abroad.
questions.promptVi: Bố mẹ cô ấy luôn ___ với quyết định đi du học của cô.
questions.explanation: "Supportive" means giving encouragement or help; "affectionate" describes showing love or fondness, which doesn't specifically mean backing a decision.
questions.promptJa: 彼女の両親は、彼女が留学するという決断をいつも ___ してくれた。
questions.explanationJa: 「supportive」は励ましや助けを与えることを意味する。「affectionate」は愛情を示すことを表すが、決断を後押しするという意味は含まれない。

questions.prompt: The little girl gave her grandmother a big, ___ hug before leaving.
questions.promptVi: Cô bé đã ôm bà một cách ___ trước khi rời đi.
questions.explanation: "Affectionate" describes showing warmth and love; "strict" means demanding obedience to rules, and "rude" means impolite, neither of which fits a warm hug.
questions.promptJa: その少女は出発前に祖母を ___ に抱きしめた。
questions.explanationJa: 「affectionate」は愛情を込めた温かさを表す。「strict」は規則に厳しいという意味で、「rude」は失礼だという意味であり、どちらも温かい抱擁には合わない。

questions.prompt: The two brothers had a small ___ over which movie to watch.
questions.promptVi: Hai anh em đã có một cuộc ___ nhỏ về việc xem phim nào.
questions.explanation: "Quarrel" means a minor argument; "reunion" refers to a happy gathering, which contradicts the idea of a disagreement.
questions.promptJa: その二人の兄弟は、どの映画を見るかについて小さな ___ をした。
questions.explanationJa: 「quarrel」は小さな口論を意味する。「reunion」は再会という楽しい集まりを表し、意見の対立とは正反対である。

questions.prompt: My ___ and I grew up together because our mothers are sisters.
questions.promptVi: Tôi và ___ của tôi lớn lên cùng nhau vì mẹ của chúng tôi là chị em gái.
questions.explanation: "Cousin" is the child of your aunt or uncle; "stranger" is someone you do not know at all, not a family member you grew up with.
questions.promptJa: 母親同士が姉妹なので、私と ___ は一緒に育った。
questions.explanationJa: 「cousin」は自分のおじやおばの子どものことである。「stranger」はまったく知らない人のことであり、一緒に育った家族ではない。

questions.prompt: My mother's sister is my ___.
questions.promptVi: Em hoặc chị gái của mẹ tôi là ___ của tôi.
questions.explanation: "Aunt" is your mother's or father's sister; "cousin" is the child of an aunt or uncle, one generation younger, not the sister herself.
questions.promptJa: 母の姉妹は私の ___ である。
questions.explanationJa: 「aunt」は母または父の姉妹のことである。「cousin」はおばやおじの子どもであり、その姉妹自身ではない。

questions.prompt: The man living right next to our house is our ___.
questions.promptVi: Người đàn ông sống ngay cạnh nhà chúng tôi là ___ của chúng tôi.
questions.explanation: "Neighbor" is someone who lives near you, such as next door; "roommate" is someone who shares your own home with you, not a person living in a separate house nearby.
questions.promptJa: 私たちの家のすぐ隣に住んでいる男性は、私たちの ___ である。
questions.explanationJa: 「neighbor」は隣の家など、近くに住んでいる人のことである。「roommate」は同じ家に一緒に住む人のことであり、近くの別の家に住む人ではない。

questions.prompt: After many years together, the couple built strong ___ in each other.
questions.promptVi: Sau nhiều năm bên nhau, cặp đôi đã xây dựng được ___ vững chắc với nhau.
questions.explanation: "Trust" is the confident belief that someone is honest and reliable, exactly what a couple builds over many years together; "jealousy" and "anger" are negative feelings that partners would not intentionally build, and "patience" means calmly tolerating something, not a bond shared between two people.
questions.promptJa: 長年一緒にいる中で、その夫婦はお互いへの強い ___ を築いた。
questions.explanationJa: 「trust」は相手が正直で頼りになるという確信であり、長年連れ添った夫婦がまさに築くものである。「jealousy」や「anger」は否定的な感情であり、パートナー同士が意図して築くものではない。「patience」は物事に我慢強くいることを意味し、二人の間の絆を表す言葉ではない。

questions.prompt: He felt bad about the argument, so he wrote his sister a short ___.
questions.promptVi: Anh ấy cảm thấy áy náy về cuộc cãi vã, nên đã viết cho em gái một ___ ngắn.
questions.explanation: "Apology" is a statement expressing regret for doing something wrong, which fits since he felt bad about the argument; "complaint" expresses dissatisfaction or blame, the opposite of feeling sorry, so it does not fit here.
questions.promptJa: 彼はけんかのことを申し訳なく思い、妹に短い ___ を書いた。
questions.explanationJa: 「apology」は悪いことをしたことについて謝罪の気持ちを表す言葉であり、彼がけんかを申し訳なく思っていることに合う。「complaint」は不満や非難を表す言葉であり、申し訳なく思う気持ちとは正反対である。

questions.prompt: She found a real ___ at the market — a jacket for only $10.
questions.promptVi: Cô ấy đã tìm thấy một ___ thực sự ở chợ — một chiếc áo khoác chỉ với 10 đô la.
questions.explanation: "Bargain" means something bought cheaply relative to its value; "discount" refers to a price reduction offered by a seller, not the item itself being a great deal.
questions.promptJa: 彼女は市場で本当にいい ___ を見つけた。ジャケットがたった10ドルだった。
questions.explanationJa: 「bargain」は価値に対して安く買えたものを意味する。「discount」は販売者が提供する値引きのことで、商品そのものがお得だという意味ではない。

questions.prompt: The shirt didn't fit, so I returned it and got a full ___.
questions.promptVi: Chiếc áo không vừa, vì vậy tôi đã trả lại và nhận được ___ đầy đủ.
questions.explanation: "Refund" means money given back; "deposit" means money paid in advance to secure something, the opposite direction of money, so it doesn't match getting money back.
questions.promptJa: そのシャツはサイズが合わなかったので、返品して全額の ___ を受け取った。
questions.explanationJa: 「refund」は返金されるお金を意味する。「deposit」は前払いで支払うお金のことで、お金の流れの向きが逆であり、返金とは合わない。

questions.prompt: Which word means a printed slip that proves you paid for something?
questions.promptVi: Từ nào có nghĩa là một tờ giấy in ra để chứng minh bạn đã thanh toán cho một thứ gì đó?
questions.explanation: "Receipt" is the printed proof of purchase; "bargain" refers to a good deal, not a piece of paper.
questions.promptJa: 何かの代金を支払ったことを証明する印刷された紙を意味する言葉はどれですか。
questions.explanationJa: 「receipt」は購入の証明となる印刷物のことである。「bargain」はお得な取引を意味し、紙そのものではない。

questions.prompt: Students get a 15% ___ on movie tickets with a valid ID.
questions.promptVi: Học sinh được ___ 15% cho vé xem phim nếu có thẻ học sinh hợp lệ.
questions.explanation: "Discount" means a reduction in price; "refund" means money paid back after a purchase, which doesn't match a reduced ticket price.
questions.promptJa: 学生は有効な学生証があれば、映画のチケットが15%の ___ になる。
questions.explanationJa: 「discount」は価格の割引を意味する。「refund」は購入後に返金されるお金のことで、チケットの割引価格とは異なる。

questions.prompt: We spent an hour just ___ the shelves without buying anything.
questions.promptVi: Chúng tôi đã dành cả tiếng đồng hồ chỉ để ___ qua các kệ hàng mà không mua gì.
questions.explanation: "Browse" means to look around casually without a specific purchase in mind; "bargain" refers to negotiating a price, not the act of looking.
questions.promptJa: 私たちは何も買わずに、ただ棚を ___ するだけで1時間を過ごした。
questions.explanationJa: 「browse」は特定の目的なく気軽に見て回ることを意味する。「bargain」は値段交渉やお得な取引を意味し、見て回る行為そのものではない。

questions.prompt: At the checkout, the ___ scanned all our items and told us the total.
questions.promptVi: Tại quầy thanh toán, ___ đã quét tất cả các món hàng của chúng tôi và báo tổng tiền.
questions.explanation: "Cashier" is the person who scans items and takes payment at a store; "customer" is the person buying things, not the one operating the register.
questions.promptJa: レジで、___ は私たちの商品をすべてスキャンして合計金額を教えてくれた。
questions.explanationJa: 「cashier」は店でレジを操作し、商品をスキャンして支払いを受ける人のことである。「customer」は買い物をする人のことであり、レジを操作する人ではない。

questions.prompt: She pushed a heavy ___ full of groceries through the store.
questions.promptVi: Cô ấy đẩy một ___ nặng đầy hàng tạp hóa qua cửa hàng.
questions.explanation: "Cart" is a large wheeled container used to carry many items around a store; "basket" is a smaller container usually carried by hand, not pushed on wheels.
questions.promptJa: 彼女は食料品でいっぱいの重い ___ を押して店の中を歩いた。
questions.explanationJa: 「cart」は店の中でたくさんの商品を運ぶための大きな車輪付きの容器である。「basket」は普通手で持つ小さめの容器であり、車輪で押すものではない。

questions.prompt: Before buying the shirt, he checked the ___ to see the cost.
questions.promptVi: Trước khi mua chiếc áo, anh ấy kiểm tra ___ để xem giá.
questions.explanation: "Price tag" is the small label attached to an item showing its cost; "coupon" is a piece of paper or code that gives a discount, not the label itself.
questions.promptJa: シャツを買う前に、彼は値段を確認するために ___ をチェックした。
questions.explanationJa: 「price tag」は商品につけられた値段を示す小さな札のことである。「coupon」は割引を受けられる紙やコードのことであり、値段の札そのものではない。

questions.prompt: Since the shoes were too small, she asked the store for an ___.
questions.promptVi: Vì đôi giày quá nhỏ, cô ấy đã yêu cầu cửa hàng cho ___.
questions.explanation: "Exchange" means swapping a purchased item for a different one, often a different size; "item" is simply a general word for a single product, not the act of swapping it.
questions.promptJa: 靴が小さすぎたので、彼女は店に ___ を頼んだ。
questions.explanationJa: 「exchange」は購入した商品を別の商品、多くの場合別のサイズと交換することを意味する。「item」は単に一つの商品を指す一般的な言葉であり、交換する行為そのものではない。

questions.prompt: If the laptop breaks within a year, the ___ lets you repair it for free.
questions.promptVi: Nếu máy tính xách tay hỏng trong vòng một năm, ___ sẽ giúp bạn được sửa miễn phí.
questions.explanation: "Warranty" is a company's written promise to repair or replace a product for free within a certain time, which is why it lets you get a free repair; "manual" is simply the instruction booklet, not a promise of free repair.
questions.promptJa: もしノートパソコンが1年以内に壊れたら、___ があれば無料で修理してもらえる。
questions.explanationJa: 「warranty」は一定期間内であれば無料で修理または交換することを約束する会社の保証であり、だからこそ無料で修理してもらえる。「manual」は単なる説明書のことであり、無料修理の約束ではない。

questions.prompt: Our travel agent prepared a detailed ___ for the two-week trip.
questions.promptVi: Nhân viên du lịch của chúng tôi đã chuẩn bị một ___ chi tiết cho chuyến đi hai tuần.
questions.explanation: "Itinerary" means a planned route or schedule for a trip; "luggage" refers to bags, not a travel plan.
questions.promptJa: 私たちの旅行代理店は、2週間の旅行のために詳しい ___ を用意してくれた。
questions.explanationJa: 「itinerary」は旅行の計画やスケジュールを意味する。「luggage」は荷物を指し、旅行計画ではない。

questions.prompt: Please make sure your ___ doesn't exceed the airline's weight limit.
questions.promptVi: Hãy đảm bảo ___ của bạn không vượt quá giới hạn cân nặng của hãng hàng không.
questions.explanation: "Luggage" refers to bags and suitcases; "itinerary" is a travel schedule, which cannot have a weight limit.
questions.promptJa: あなたの ___ が航空会社の重量制限を超えないようにしてください。
questions.explanationJa: 「luggage」はかばんやスーツケースを指す。「itinerary」は旅程表であり、重量制限を持つことはできない。

questions.prompt: Which word means a period of time when something happens later than planned?
questions.promptVi: Từ nào có nghĩa là khoảng thời gian mà một việc gì đó diễn ra muộn hơn kế hoạch?
questions.explanation: "Delay" means something happens later than planned; "transfer" means moving from one place or vehicle to another, unrelated to timing.
questions.promptJa: 何かが予定より遅く起こる期間を意味する言葉はどれですか。
questions.explanationJa: 「delay」は予定より遅れて何かが起こることを意味する。「transfer」はある場所や乗り物から別のものへ移ることを意味し、時間の遅れとは関係がない。

questions.prompt: Passengers should ___ the plane at least thirty minutes before departure.
questions.promptVi: Hành khách nên ___ máy bay ít nhất ba mươi phút trước giờ khởi hành.
questions.explanation: "Board" means to get onto a plane, train, or ship; "delay" refers to being late, not the act of getting on board.
questions.promptJa: 乗客は出発の少なくとも30分前に飛行機に ___ すべきである。
questions.explanationJa: 「board」は飛行機や電車、船に乗り込むことを意味する。「delay」は遅れることを表し、乗り込む行為ではない。

questions.prompt: We had to ___ to a different train at the next station.
questions.promptVi: Chúng tôi phải ___ sang một chuyến tàu khác tại ga tiếp theo.
questions.explanation: "Transfer" means to switch from one vehicle to another; "board" means simply getting on a vehicle, not switching between two.
questions.promptJa: 私たちは次の駅で別の電車に ___ しなければならなかった。
questions.explanationJa: 「transfer」はある乗り物から別の乗り物へ乗り換えることを意味する。「board」は単に乗り物に乗ることを意味し、乗り換えることではない。

questions.prompt: Before boarding the train, you must buy a ___ at the counter.
questions.promptVi: Trước khi lên tàu, bạn phải mua một ___ tại quầy.
questions.explanation: "Ticket" is the paper or digital pass that allows you to travel on a train; "map" shows directions or locations, not permission to board a train.
questions.promptJa: 電車に乗る前に、窓口で ___ を買わなければならない。
questions.explanationJa: 「ticket」は電車に乗ることを許可する紙またはデジタルのパスのことである。「map」は方向や場所を示すものであり、電車に乗る許可ではない。

questions.prompt: Passengers wait on the ___ for the train to arrive.
questions.promptVi: Hành khách đứng chờ ở ___ để tàu đến.
questions.explanation: "Platform" is the area beside the tracks where passengers wait for and board a train; "escalator" is a moving staircase, not the waiting area next to the tracks.
questions.promptJa: 乗客は電車が来るのを ___ で待つ。
questions.explanationJa: 「platform」は乗客が電車を待ったり乗ったりする線路のそばのエリアのことである。「escalator」は動く階段のことであり、線路のそばの待機エリアではない。

questions.prompt: The bus ___ increased by fifty cents this month.
questions.promptVi: ___ xe buýt đã tăng thêm năm mươi xu trong tháng này.
questions.explanation: "Fare" is the amount of money you pay to travel on a bus, train, or taxi; "conductor" is the person who checks tickets, not the price itself.
questions.promptJa: 今月、バスの ___ が50セント値上がりした。
questions.explanationJa: 「fare」はバスや電車、タクシーに乗るために支払うお金のことである。「conductor」は切符を確認する人のことであり、料金そのものではない。

questions.prompt: Passengers for flight 202 should go to ___ twelve now.
questions.promptVi: Hành khách của chuyến bay 202 nên đến ___ số mười hai ngay bây giờ.
questions.explanation: "Gate" is the specific area at an airport where passengers board their flight; "kiosk" is a small booth used for information or buying tickets, not the boarding area.
questions.promptJa: 202便の乗客は今すぐ12番 ___ に向かってください。
questions.explanationJa: 「gate」は空港で乗客が飛行機に搭乗する特定のエリアのことである。「kiosk」は案内やチケット購入のための小さなブースであり、搭乗エリアではない。

questions.prompt: Since it was raining heavily, we called a ___ instead of walking home.
questions.promptVi: Vì trời mưa to, chúng tôi đã gọi một ___ thay vì đi bộ về nhà.
questions.explanation: "Taxi" is a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere; "bicycle" is a two-wheeled vehicle you pedal yourself, not one with a paid driver.
questions.promptJa: 雨がひどかったので、私たちは歩いて帰る代わりに ___ を呼んだ。
questions.explanationJa: 「taxi」はお金を払って運転してもらう車のことである。「bicycle」は自分でペダルをこぐ二輪の乗り物であり、有料の運転手がいる乗り物ではない。

questions.prompt: Summer in this city is extremely ___, so the air always feels sticky.
questions.promptVi: Mùa hè ở thành phố này cực kỳ ___, nên không khí lúc nào cũng cảm giác dính bết.
questions.explanation: "Humid" means having a high amount of moisture in the air; "chilly" means slightly cold, which contradicts a hot, sticky summer.
questions.promptJa: この街の夏はとても ___ なので、空気はいつもべたつく感じがする。
questions.explanationJa: 「humid」は空気中の湿気が多いことを意味する。「chilly」は少し寒いことを意味し、暑くてじめじめした夏とは矛盾する。

questions.prompt: Which word means a prediction of what the weather will be like?
questions.promptVi: Từ nào có nghĩa là dự đoán về thời tiết sẽ như thế nào?
questions.explanation: "Forecast" means a prediction about future weather; "breeze" refers to a gentle wind, not a prediction.
questions.promptJa: 天気がどうなるかについての予測を意味する言葉はどれですか。
questions.explanationJa: 「forecast」は将来の天気についての予測を意味する。「breeze」は穏やかな風を指し、予測ではない。

questions.prompt: It gets ___ in the evenings, so bring a light jacket.
questions.promptVi: Trời trở nên ___ vào buổi tối, vì vậy hãy mang theo một chiếc áo khoác mỏng.
questions.explanation: "Chilly" means slightly cold; "humid" describes moisture in the air, not temperature, so it doesn't explain the need for a jacket.
questions.promptJa: 夕方は ___ になるので、薄手のジャケットを持ってきてください。
questions.explanationJa: 「chilly」は少し寒いことを意味する。「humid」は空気中の湿気を表し、気温ではないため、ジャケットが必要な理由にはならない。

questions.prompt: Only a light ___ was falling, so we didn't need an umbrella.
questions.promptVi: Chỉ có một cơn ___ nhẹ đang rơi, nên chúng tôi không cần dù.
questions.explanation: "Drizzle" means very light rain; "breeze" refers to wind, which is unrelated to the context of rain.
questions.promptJa: 軽い ___ が降っているだけだったので、私たちは傘を必要としなかった。
questions.explanationJa: 「drizzle」はごく軽い雨を意味する。「breeze」は風のことで、雨の文脈には合わない。

questions.prompt: A cool ___ from the sea made the hot afternoon more bearable.
questions.promptVi: Một cơn ___ mát mẻ từ biển thổi vào khiến buổi chiều nóng bức trở nên dễ chịu hơn.
questions.explanation: "Breeze" means a light, gentle wind; "drizzle" refers to light rain, which is unrelated to the cooling wind described here.
questions.promptJa: 海からの涼しい ___ が吹き込み、暑い午後を過ごしやすくしてくれた。
questions.explanationJa: 「breeze」は穏やかな軽い風を意味する。「drizzle」は小雨を指し、ここで説明されている涼しい風とは関係がない。

questions.prompt: During the storm, the loud ___ shook the windows and scared the dog.
questions.promptVi: Trong cơn bão, tiếng ___ lớn làm rung cửa sổ và làm con chó sợ hãi.
questions.explanation: "Thunder" is the loud rumbling sound during a storm; "breeze" is a light wind, not a loud sound. "Lightning" is a flash of light, not a sound, and "storm" refers to the whole weather event already named in "During the storm," not the loud noise itself.
questions.promptJa: 嵐の間、大きな ___ が窓を揺らし、犬を怖がらせた。
questions.explanationJa: 「thunder」は嵐の間に鳴る大きな轟音を意味する。「breeze」は穏やかな風のことで、大きな音ではない。「lightning」は光る現象であり音ではない。「storm」は「During the storm」で既に述べられている嵐そのものを指し、大きな音自体ではない。

questions.prompt: A flash of ___ lit up the dark sky during the storm.
questions.promptVi: Một tia ___ chiếu sáng bầu trời tối trong cơn bão.
questions.explanation: "Lightning" is the bright flash of light that occurs during a storm; "thunder" is the loud sound that follows it, not a flash of light, and "rain"/"hail" are precipitation falling from the sky, not a burst of light.
questions.promptJa: 嵐の最中、暗い空を ___ が照らした。
questions.explanationJa: 「lightning」は嵐の間に見える明るい閃光を意味する。「thunder」はその後に聞こえる音であり、光そのものではない。「rain」や「hail」は空から降る雨や雹のことであり、光ではない。

questions.prompt: Vietnam has a tropical ___, so it is warm for most of the year.
questions.promptVi: Việt Nam có ___ nhiệt đới, nên phần lớn thời gian trong năm đều ấm áp.
questions.explanation: "Climate" describes the typical weather pattern of a region over a long time; "forecast" is a short-term prediction of the weather, not a long-term pattern.
questions.promptJa: ベトナムは熱帯 ___ に属し、一年の大半が暖かい。
questions.explanationJa: 「climate」はある地域の長期的な典型的天候パターンを表す。「forecast」は短期的な天気の予測であり、長期的なパターンではない。

questions.prompt: In winter, it gets so ___ that the lake turns to ice.
questions.promptVi: Vào mùa đông, trời trở nên ___ đến mức mặt hồ đóng băng.
questions.explanation: "Frigid" means extremely cold, cold enough to turn water into ice; "humid" describes moisture in the air, which has nothing to do with ice forming.
questions.promptJa: 冬はとても ___ になり、湖が凍る。
questions.explanationJa: 「frigid」は氷ができるほど極めて寒いことを意味する。「humid」は空気中の湿気を表す言葉で、氷ができることとは関係がない。

questions.prompt: This morning was so ___ that drivers could barely see the road.
questions.promptVi: Sáng nay trời ___ đến mức người lái xe khó có thể nhìn thấy đường.
questions.explanation: "Foggy" means covered in thick fog, which reduces visibility; "freezing" means very cold temperature, which does not by itself explain poor visibility.
questions.promptJa: 今朝はとても ___ で、運転手たちは道路がほとんど見えなかった。
questions.explanationJa: 「foggy」は濃い霧に覆われていることを意味し、視界を悪くする。「freezing」は非常に寒い気温を意味し、それ自体は視界の悪さを説明しない。

questions.prompt: On weekends, she enjoys reading novels in her ___ time.
questions.promptVi: Vào cuối tuần, cô ấy thích đọc tiểu thuyết trong thời gian ___ của mình.
questions.explanation: "Leisure" means free time for relaxation or enjoyment; "hike" refers to a walking activity, not a period of time.
questions.promptJa: 週末、彼女は ___ の時間に小説を読むのを楽しんでいる。
questions.explanationJa: 「leisure」はくつろぎや楽しみのための自由な時間を意味する。「hike」は徒歩での活動を指し、時間の概念ではない。

questions.prompt: He loves to ___ old coins from different countries.
questions.promptVi: Anh ấy thích ___ những đồng xu cổ từ nhiều quốc gia khác nhau.
questions.explanation: "Collect" means to gather items as a hobby; "relax" means to rest, which doesn't fit the action of gathering coins.
questions.promptJa: 彼は色々な国の古いコインを ___ するのが好きだ。
questions.explanationJa: 「collect」は趣味として物を集めることを意味する。「relax」は休むことを意味し、コインを集める行為には合わない。

questions.prompt: Which word means to draw something quickly without much detail?
questions.promptVi: Từ nào có nghĩa là vẽ nhanh một thứ gì đó mà không cần quá nhiều chi tiết?
questions.explanation: "Sketch" means a quick, rough drawing; "leisure" refers to free time, unrelated to drawing.
questions.promptJa: あまり細かくせずに素早く何かを描くことを意味する言葉はどれですか。
questions.explanationJa: 「sketch」は簡単な、詳細でない素早い絵を意味する。「leisure」は自由時間のことで、絵を描くこととは関係がない。

questions.prompt: They decided to ___ up the mountain trail early in the morning.
questions.promptVi: Họ quyết định ___ lên đường mòn trên núi vào sáng sớm.
questions.explanation: "Hike" means to walk a long distance, especially in nature; "sketch" means to draw, which doesn't fit walking up a trail.
questions.promptJa: 彼らは早朝に山道を ___ することに決めた。
questions.explanationJa: 「hike」は特に自然の中で長距離を歩くことを意味する。「sketch」は絵を描くことを意味し、山道を歩くことには合わない。

questions.prompt: After a stressful week, all I want to do is ___ at home.
questions.promptVi: Sau một tuần căng thẳng, tất cả những gì tôi muốn làm là ___ ở nhà.
questions.explanation: "Relax" means to rest and reduce stress; "collect" means to gather items, which is unrelated to resting.
questions.promptJa: ストレスの多い一週間の後、私がしたいのはただ家で ___ することだけだ。
questions.explanationJa: 「relax」は休んでストレスを減らすことを意味する。「collect」は物を集めることを意味し、休息とは関係がない。

questions.prompt: On rainy days, she likes to ___ colorful scarves for her family.
questions.promptVi: Vào những ngày mưa, cô ấy thích ___ những chiếc khăn nhiều màu cho gia đình.
questions.explanation: "Knit" means to make clothing by looping yarn together, the usual way scarves are made at home; "hike" means to walk long distances outdoors, unrelated to making scarves, and "paint" means to apply color to a surface such as paper or walls, not to create a scarf from yarn.
questions.promptJa: 雨の日には、彼女は家族のためにカラフルなマフラーを ___ するのが好きだ。
questions.explanationJa: 「knit」は毛糸を編んで衣類を作ることを意味し、家庭でマフラーを作る一般的な方法である。「hike」は屋外を長距離歩くことを意味し、マフラー作りとは関係がない。「paint」は紙や壁などに色を塗ることを意味し、毛糸でマフラーを作ることではない。

questions.prompt: Every summer, their family sleeps in a tent when they go ___ in the mountains.
questions.promptVi: Mỗi mùa hè, gia đình họ ngủ trong lều khi đi ___ trên núi.
questions.explanation: "Camping" means staying outdoors and sleeping in a tent, often in nature; "fishing" means catching fish, a different outdoor activity that does not involve sleeping in a tent.
questions.promptJa: 毎年夏、家族で山へ ___ に行き、テントに泊まる。
questions.explanationJa: 「camping」は屋外でテントに泊まって過ごすことを意味する。「fishing」は魚を捕まえることを意味し、テントに泊まることとは関係がない別の屋外活動である。

questions.prompt: On a lazy Sunday, he likes to solve a jigsaw ___ at the table.
questions.promptVi: Vào một ngày Chủ nhật rảnh rỗi, anh ấy thích giải một ___ ghép hình trên bàn.
questions.explanation: "Puzzle" is a game or problem that challenges your thinking to solve, and a jigsaw puzzle is one kind made of interlocking pieces that form a picture; "game" is a general term for playful activities, less specific than a puzzle, and "picture" is just the image itself, not the challenge of assembling it.
questions.promptJa: のんびりした日曜日に、彼はテーブルでジグソー ___ を解くのが好きだ。
questions.explanationJa: 「puzzle」は頭を使って解く遊びや問題のことで、ジグソーパズルはピースを組み合わせて絵を完成させる種類の一つである。「game」は遊び全般を指す一般的な言葉で、パズルほど具体的ではなく、「picture」は単なる絵そのものであり、組み立てる課題そのものではない。

questions.prompt: Every weekend, he likes to ___ landscapes with watercolors in the park.
questions.promptVi: Mỗi cuối tuần, anh ấy thích ___ phong cảnh bằng màu nước trong công viên.
questions.explanation: "Paint" means to create pictures using paint and brushes; "sketch" means to draw quickly without much detail, a different technique from painting with color.
questions.promptJa: 毎週末、彼は公園で水彩絵の具を使って風景を ___ するのが好きだ。
questions.explanationJa: 「paint」は絵の具と筆を使って絵を描くことを意味する。「sketch」は詳細を描かずに素早く描くことを意味し、色を使って描く「paint」とは異なる技法である。

questions.prompt: My grandmother likes to ___ every morning before breakfast, growing her own vegetables.
questions.promptVi: Bà tôi thích ___ mỗi buổi sáng trước bữa sáng, tự trồng rau của mình.
questions.explanation: "Garden" means to grow and take care of plants, such as vegetables; "knit" means to make clothing from yarn, an indoor craft unrelated to growing plants.
questions.promptJa: 祖母は朝食前に毎朝 ___ をして、自分の野菜を育てるのが好きだ。
questions.explanationJa: 「garden」は野菜などの植物を育てて世話をすることを意味する。「knit」は毛糸で衣類を作ることを意味し、植物を育てることとは関係がない。

questions.prompt: The living room is very ___, with enough space for two sofas.
questions.promptVi: Phòng khách rất ___, đủ chỗ cho hai bộ sofa.
questions.explanation: "Spacious" means having a lot of room; "cozy" means warm and comfortable but usually implies a smaller space, contradicting room for two sofas.
questions.promptJa: リビングルームはとても ___ で、ソファ2つ分のスペースがある。
questions.explanationJa: 「spacious」は広々としていることを意味する。「cozy」は暖かく居心地が良いことを意味するが、通常は狭い空間を指すため、ソファ2つ分のスペースがあるという文脈とは矛盾する。

questions.prompt: We rented a fully ___ apartment, so we didn't need to buy any furniture.
questions.promptVi: Chúng tôi đã thuê một căn hộ được ___ đầy đủ, nên không cần mua thêm đồ nội thất.
questions.explanation: "Furnished" means already equipped with furniture; "spacious" describes size, and "renovated" means recently repaired or updated, neither of which says whether furniture is included.
questions.promptJa: 私たちは完全に ___ のアパートを借りたので、家具を買う必要がなかった。
questions.explanationJa: 「furnished」はすでに家具が備え付けられていることを意味する。「spacious」は広さを表す言葉で、「renovated」は最近改装されたことを表す言葉であり、どちらも家具の有無とは関係がない。

questions.prompt: Which word means a person who pays rent to live in a property?
questions.promptVi: Từ nào có nghĩa là người trả tiền thuê để sống trong một bất động sản?
questions.explanation: "Tenant" is the person who rents and lives in a property; "landlord" is the person who owns and rents out the property, the opposite role.
questions.promptJa: 物件に住むために家賃を支払う人を意味する言葉はどれですか。
questions.explanationJa: 「tenant」は物件を借りて住む人を意味する。「landlord」は物件を所有し貸し出す側の人で、役割が逆である。

questions.prompt: If the heater breaks, you should contact the ___ to fix it.
questions.promptVi: Nếu máy sưởi bị hỏng, bạn nên liên hệ với ___ để sửa chữa.
questions.explanation: "Landlord" is the property owner responsible for repairs; "tenant" is the renter, who reports the problem rather than fixing it themselves.
questions.promptJa: ヒーターが壊れた場合は、修理してもらうために ___ に連絡すべきである。
questions.explanationJa: 「landlord」は修理の責任を持つ物件の所有者を意味する。「tenant」は借主であり、自分で修理するのではなく報告する側である。

questions.prompt: The small cabin felt warm and ___ during the winter.
questions.promptVi: Căn nhà gỗ nhỏ cảm thấy ấm áp và ___ vào mùa đông.
questions.explanation: "Cozy" means warm and comfortable, fitting a small cabin in winter; "furnished" only describes having furniture, not the warm feeling.
questions.promptJa: その小さな小屋は冬の間、暖かくて ___ に感じられた。
questions.explanationJa: 「cozy」は暖かく居心地が良いことを意味し、冬の小さな小屋にぴったり合う。「furnished」は家具があることだけを表し、暖かく居心地の良い感覚を表すわけではない。

questions.prompt: Every morning, she waters her plants on the ___ overlooking the street.
questions.promptVi: Mỗi buổi sáng, cô ấy tưới cây trên ___ nhìn ra đường phố.
questions.explanation: "Balcony" is a platform outside an upper window where you can stand outdoors; "landlord" is the person who owns and rents out property, not a part of a building.
questions.promptJa: 毎朝、彼女は通りを見渡せる ___ で植物に水をやる。
questions.explanationJa: 「balcony」は建物の上階の窓の外にある、外に立てる台のことである。「landlord」は物件を所有し貸し出す人のことで、建物の一部ではない。

questions.prompt: He parks his car in the ___ next to the house every night.
questions.promptVi: Anh ấy đỗ xe trong ___ cạnh ngôi nhà mỗi tối.
questions.explanation: "Garage" is a covered space used to park a car; "balcony" is an outdoor platform attached to a building, not a place to park vehicles.
questions.promptJa: 彼は毎晩、家の隣にある ___ に車を停める。
questions.explanationJa: 「garage」は車を停めるための屋根付きの場所を意味する。「balcony」は建物に付いた屋外の台であり、車を停める場所ではない。

questions.prompt: They store old boxes and tools in the ___ below the kitchen.
questions.promptVi: Họ cất những chiếc hộp cũ và dụng cụ trong ___ bên dưới nhà bếp.
questions.explanation: "Basement" is the level of a building below the ground floor, often used for storage; "garage" is where a car is kept, a different part of the house.
questions.promptJa: 彼らは台所の下にある ___ に古い箱や道具をしまっている。
questions.explanationJa: 「basement」は建物の地上階より下の階層で、よく収納に使われる。「garage」は車を保管する場所であり、家の別の部分である。

questions.prompt: A large lamp hangs from the ___ in the dining room.
questions.promptVi: Một chiếc đèn lớn treo từ ___ trong phòng ăn.
questions.explanation: "Ceiling" is the surface at the top of a room, above your head; "basement" is a floor below ground level, the opposite location.
questions.promptJa: ダイニングルームでは大きなランプが ___ から吊り下げられている。
questions.explanationJa: 「ceiling」は部屋の上部にある頭上の面を意味する。「basement」は地上より下の階であり、正反対の場所である。

questions.prompt: She closed the ___ to keep the sunlight out of the bedroom.
questions.promptVi: Cô ấy kéo ___ lại để ngăn ánh nắng chiếu vào phòng ngủ.
questions.explanation: "Curtain" is a piece of cloth used to cover a window and block light; "ceiling" is the top surface of a room, unrelated to blocking sunlight; closing a "window" still lets sunlight through the glass, so only a curtain can block it out; and "hallway" is a passage between rooms, not something used to cover a window.
questions.promptJa: 彼女は寝室に日光が入らないように ___ を閉めた。
questions.explanationJa: 「curtain」は窓を覆い光を遮るための布を意味する。「ceiling」は部屋の上部の面であり、日光を遮ることとは関係がない。「window」を閉めてもガラス越しに日光は入ってしまうため、それを遮れるのはカーテンだけである。「hallway」は部屋の間の通路であり、窓にかけるものではない。

questions.prompt: I had lunch with a ___ from the marketing department.
questions.promptVi: Tôi đã ăn trưa cùng một ___ từ phòng marketing.
questions.explanation: "Colleague" means a person you work with; "promotion" refers to a job advancement, not a person.
questions.promptJa: 私はマーケティング部の ___ とランチを食べた。
questions.explanationJa: 「colleague」は一緒に働く人を意味する。「promotion」は昇進のことで、人を指す言葉ではない。

questions.prompt: After five years of hard work, she finally received a ___ to manager.
questions.promptVi: Sau năm năm làm việc chăm chỉ, cô ấy cuối cùng đã được ___ lên quản lý.
questions.explanation: "Promotion" means being given a higher position; "demotion" means being moved to a lower-ranking position, the opposite of an achievement earned after five years of hard work; "salary" refers to pay, which is separate from job rank.
questions.promptJa: 5年間一生懸命働いた後、彼女はついにマネージャーへの ___ を受けた。
questions.explanationJa: 「promotion」はより高い地位を与えられることを意味する。「demotion」はより低い地位に移されることを意味し、5年間の努力が実った成果とは正反対である。「salary」は給料のことで、役職とは別のものである。

questions.prompt: Which word means the fixed amount of money an employee is paid regularly?
questions.promptVi: Từ nào có nghĩa là số tiền cố định mà một nhân viên được trả đều đặn?
questions.explanation: "Salary" is the regular fixed pay for a job; "interview" refers to a meeting to assess a candidate, unrelated to pay.
questions.promptJa: 従業員が定期的に支払われる決まった金額を意味する言葉はどれですか。
questions.explanationJa: 「salary」は仕事に対して定期的に支払われる決まった給料を意味する。「interview」は候補者を評価するための面談のことで、給料とは関係がない。

questions.prompt: He decided to ___ from his job to start his own business.
questions.promptVi: Anh ấy quyết định ___ khỏi công việc để bắt đầu kinh doanh riêng.
questions.explanation: "Resign" means to formally quit a job; "promotion" means advancing in a job, the opposite of leaving it.
questions.promptJa: 彼は自分のビジネスを始めるために仕事を ___ することに決めた。
questions.explanationJa: 「resign」は正式に仕事を辞めることを意味する。「promotion」は昇進することを意味し、辞めることとは正反対である。

questions.prompt: She practiced answering common questions before the job ___.
questions.promptVi: Cô ấy đã luyện tập trả lời các câu hỏi thường gặp trước buổi ___ xin việc.
questions.explanation: "Interview" is a formal meeting to evaluate a job candidate; "colleague" refers to a co-worker, unrelated to the hiring process.
questions.promptJa: 彼女は就職 ___ の前に、よくある質問への答え方を練習した。
questions.explanationJa: 「interview」は就職候補者を評価するための正式な面談を意味する。「colleague」は同僚のことで、採用の過程とは関係がない。

questions.prompt: Before applying for the job, she updated her ___ with her latest experience.
questions.promptVi: Trước khi ứng tuyển công việc, cô ấy đã cập nhật ___ với kinh nghiệm mới nhất.
questions.explanation: "Resume" is a document listing your work experience and skills; "salary" is the money you are paid, not a document.
questions.promptJa: 仕事に応募する前に、彼女は最新の経験を加えて ___ を更新した。
questions.explanationJa: 「resume」は職歴やスキルを記載した書類を意味する。「salary」は支払われるお金のことで、書類ではない。

questions.prompt: He works the night ___ at the hospital three times a week.
questions.promptVi: Anh ấy làm ___ đêm tại bệnh viện ba lần một tuần.
questions.explanation: "Shift" is a scheduled period of work time, such as a night shift; "resume" is a document about your work history, not a period of time.
questions.promptJa: 彼は病院で週に3回、夜間の ___ で働いている。
questions.explanationJa: 「shift」は夜勤のような、決められた勤務時間を意味する。「resume」は職歴に関する書類であり、時間帯を表すものではない。

questions.prompt: She asked her ___ for a day off next week.
questions.promptVi: Cô ấy xin ___ của mình cho nghỉ một ngày vào tuần tới.
questions.explanation: "Boss" is the person who manages and supervises employees at work; "shift" is a period of working time, not a person.
questions.promptJa: 彼女は来週一日休みをもらうために ___ に頼んだ。
questions.explanationJa: 「boss」は職場で従業員を管理し監督する人を意味する。「shift」は勤務時間のことで、人を指す言葉ではない。

questions.prompt: The company plans to ___ ten new employees next month because business is growing fast.
questions.promptVi: Công ty dự định ___ mười nhân viên mới vào tháng tới vì việc kinh doanh đang phát triển nhanh.
questions.explanation: "Hire" means to give someone a job, which fits a growing business that needs more staff; "fire" and "lose" both mean losing employees, the opposite of adding new staff, and "promote" means giving a current employee a higher position, not adding brand-new employees.
questions.promptJa: 会社は業績が急速に伸びているため、来月新しい社員を十人 ___ する予定だ。
questions.explanationJa: 「hire」は人に仕事を与えることを意味し、業績が伸びて人手が必要な会社の状況に合う。「fire」と「lose」はどちらも従業員を失うことを意味し、新しく人を増やすこととは正反対である。「promote」は既存の社員をより上の役職にすることを意味し、新しい社員を増やすことではない。

questions.prompt: New employees must complete two weeks of ___ before starting their job.
questions.promptVi: Nhân viên mới phải hoàn thành hai tuần ___ trước khi bắt đầu công việc.
questions.explanation: "Training" means a period of learning the skills specifically needed for a new job; "class" can also mean a general lesson, but it does not specifically mean job-related preparation the way training does, and "interview"/"vacation" are unrelated to a learning period at all.
questions.promptJa: 新入社員は仕事を始める前に二週間の ___ を修了しなければならない。
questions.explanationJa: 「training」は新しい仕事に必要なスキルを学ぶ期間を意味する。「class」も一般的な授業を指せるが、仕事のための準備を意味する言葉としては「training」ほど的確ではない。「interview」や「vacation」は学習期間とはまったく関係がない。

questions.prompt: Check the class ___ to see what time math starts.
questions.promptVi: Hãy kiểm tra ___ lớp học để biết giờ nào môn toán bắt đầu.
questions.explanation: "Schedule" means a timetable of planned activities; "assignment" refers to homework, not the timing of classes.
questions.promptJa: 数学が何時に始まるかを知るために、クラスの ___ を確認してください。
questions.explanationJa: 「schedule」は計画された活動の時間割を意味する。「assignment」は宿題のことで、授業の時間とは関係がない。

questions.prompt: The teacher gave us a writing ___ due next Monday.
questions.promptVi: Giáo viên đã giao cho chúng tôi một ___ viết cần nộp vào thứ Hai tới.
questions.explanation: "Assignment" means a task given to be completed, such as homework; "grade" refers to a score, not a task, and a "pencil" is a tool for writing, not something that can be "due".
questions.promptJa: 先生は来週の月曜日までに提出する作文の ___ を出した。
questions.explanationJa: 「assignment」は宿題のような、行うべき課題を意味する。「grade」は成績のことで課題ではなく、「pencil」は書くための道具であり、「due」(締め切りがある)とは結びつかない。

questions.prompt: Which word means a student who is in the same class as you?
questions.promptVi: Từ nào có nghĩa là một học sinh học cùng lớp với bạn?
questions.explanation: "Classmate" means a fellow student in the same class; "absent" describes being away, not a person.
questions.promptJa: あなたと同じクラスにいる生徒を意味する言葉はどれですか。
questions.explanationJa: 「classmate」は同じクラスの生徒仲間を意味する。「absent」は欠席していることを表す言葉で、人を指すものではない。

questions.prompt: He was ___ from school yesterday because he was sick.
questions.promptVi: Anh ấy đã ___ ở trường hôm qua vì bị ốm.
questions.explanation: "Absent" means not present; "classmate" refers to a person, which doesn't fit describing someone's attendance status.
questions.promptJa: 彼は昨日、病気だったので学校を ___ だった。
questions.explanationJa: 「absent」は不在であることを意味する。「classmate」は人を指す言葉であり、出席状況を表すものではない。

questions.prompt: She was proud of the high ___ she got on her science test.
questions.promptVi: Cô ấy tự hào về ___ cao mà mình đạt được trong bài kiểm tra khoa học.
questions.explanation: "Grade" means a score or mark given for schoolwork; "schedule" refers to timing, unrelated to test results.
questions.promptJa: 彼女は理科のテストで取った高い ___ を誇りに思っていた。
questions.explanationJa: 「grade」は学業に対して与えられる点数や評価を意味する。「schedule」は時間割のことで、テストの結果とは関係がない。

questions.prompt: She forgot her math ___, so she could not read the lesson in class.
questions.promptVi: Cô ấy quên mang ___ toán nên không thể đọc bài học trong lớp.
questions.explanation: "Textbook" is a book used for studying a school subject, which she needs to read the lesson; "grade" is a score for schoolwork, not something you carry to class, and "exam"/"recess" refer to a test or a break time, not a book that could be forgotten.
questions.promptJa: 彼女は数学の ___ を忘れたため、授業で内容を読めなかった。
questions.explanationJa: 「textbook」は学校の科目を勉強するために使う本のことで、授業の内容を読むために必要である。「grade」は学業に対する評価であり、持って行くものではない。「exam」や「recess」はテストや休み時間を指し、忘れられるような本ではない。

questions.prompt: Students must study hard to pass the final ___ next week.
questions.promptVi: Học sinh phải học chăm chỉ để vượt qua kỳ ___ cuối kỳ vào tuần tới.
questions.explanation: "Exam" is a formal test of knowledge; "textbook" is a study book, not a test.
questions.promptJa: 生徒たちは来週の期末 ___ に合格するために一生懸命勉強しなければならない。
questions.explanationJa: 「exam」は知識を測る正式なテストを意味する。「textbook」は勉強用の本であり、テストではない。

questions.prompt: He stayed up late finishing his science ___ for tomorrow.
questions.promptVi: Anh ấy thức khuya để hoàn thành ___ môn khoa học cho ngày mai.
questions.explanation: "Project" is a school task that often takes several days to complete, such as a science project; "exam" is a formal test, not an ongoing task.
questions.promptJa: 彼は明日のために理科の ___ を終わらせようと夜遅くまで起きていた。
questions.explanationJa: 「project」は数日かけて取り組む学校の課題を意味し、理科の自由研究などが例である。「exam」は正式なテストのことで、継続的な課題ではない。

questions.prompt: The first ___ of the school year ends in December.
questions.promptVi: ___ đầu tiên của năm học kết thúc vào tháng Mười Hai.
questions.explanation: "Semester" is a half-year term used to divide the school year; "lecture" is a single class or talk, not a length of time.
questions.promptJa: 学年最初の ___ は12月に終わる。
questions.explanationJa: 「semester」は学年を分ける半年単位の期間を意味する。「lecture」は一回の授業や講義のことで、期間の長さを表す言葉ではない。

questions.prompt: After class, she studies quietly in the ___ surrounded by books.
questions.promptVi: Sau giờ học, cô ấy học bài yên tĩnh trong ___, xung quanh toàn sách.
questions.explanation: "Library" is a place with many books where people read or study; "semester" is a period of the school year, not a physical place.
questions.promptJa: 放課後、彼女は本に囲まれた ___ で静かに勉強する。
questions.explanationJa: 「library」は本がたくさんあり、人々が読書や勉強をする場所を意味する。「semester」は学年の期間のことで、場所ではない。

questions.prompt: She went to the ATM to ___ some cash for the weekend.
questions.promptVi: Cô ấy đã đến cây ATM để ___ một ít tiền mặt cho cuối tuần.
questions.explanation: "Withdraw" means to take money out of an account; "transaction" is a general term for any banking activity, less specific than taking out cash.
questions.promptJa: 彼女は週末のために現金を ___ するためにATMへ行った。
questions.explanationJa: 「withdraw」は口座からお金を引き出すことを意味する。「transaction」はあらゆる銀行取引を指す一般的な言葉で、ここでの現金を引き出す行為ほど具体的ではない。

questions.prompt: Which word means the extra money a bank pays you for keeping savings there, or charges you for borrowing?
questions.promptVi: Từ nào có nghĩa là khoản tiền thêm mà ngân hàng trả cho bạn khi gửi tiết kiệm, hoặc tính phí khi bạn vay?
questions.explanation: "Interest" is the extra money earned on savings or charged on loans; "overdraft" refers to spending more than the account balance, a different concept.
questions.promptJa: 銀行が貯金に対して支払う、または借り入れに対して請求する追加のお金を意味する言葉はどれですか。
questions.explanationJa: 「interest」は貯金に対して得られる、または借り入れに対して請求される追加のお金を意味する。「overdraft」は口座残高以上に使ってしまうことを指し、異なる概念である。

questions.prompt: Every ___ on your account is recorded in the monthly statement.
questions.promptVi: Mỗi ___ trên tài khoản của bạn đều được ghi lại trong sao kê hàng tháng.
questions.explanation: "Transaction" refers to any banking activity such as a withdrawal, payment, or transfer, which is exactly what appears on a monthly statement; "teller" is a bank employee who handles customer transactions in person, not an event that gets logged in a statement, so it doesn't fit the meaning here.
questions.promptJa: あなたの口座でのすべての ___ は、月次明細書に記録される。
questions.explanationJa: 「transaction」は引き出し・支払い・振込など、月次明細書に記録されるあらゆる銀行取引を指す。「teller」は窓口で顧客の取引を扱う銀行員のことであり、明細書に記録される出来事ではないため、ここでは意味が合わない。

questions.prompt: He spent more than he had and went into ___ on his checking account.
questions.promptVi: Anh ấy đã tiêu nhiều hơn số tiền mình có và bị ___ trên tài khoản thanh toán.
questions.explanation: "Overdraft" means spending more money than is available in the account; "installment" refers to a partial payment plan, unrelated to overspending.
questions.promptJa: 彼は持っているお金より多く使ってしまい、当座預金口座で ___ になった。
questions.explanationJa: 「overdraft」は口座にある金額以上を使ってしまうことを意味する。「installment」は分割払いのことで、使いすぎとは関係がない。

questions.prompt: Instead of paying the full price at once, she paid for the laptop with one ___ per month.
questions.promptVi: Thay vì trả toàn bộ giá một lần, cô ấy đã trả tiền mua laptop bằng một ___ mỗi tháng.
questions.explanation: "Installment" means one of several partial payments; "withdrawal" refers to taking money out of an account, not paying in parts; "statement" is a monthly record of transactions, not a method of paying for something.
questions.promptJa: 全額を一度に支払う代わりに、彼女はノートパソコンの代金を毎月1回の ___ で支払った。
questions.explanationJa: 「installment」は分割払いの1回分を意味する。「withdrawal」は口座からお金を引き出すことを意味し、分割して支払うこととは異なる。「statement」は毎月の取引記録であり、支払いの方法ではない。

questions.prompt: They took out a thirty-year ___ to buy their first house.
questions.promptVi: Họ đã vay một khoản ___ thế chấp 30 năm để mua căn nhà đầu tiên.
questions.explanation: "Mortgage" means a loan specifically used to buy property, repaid over a long period; "overdraft" refers to spending more than an account balance, a different type of borrowing.
questions.promptJa: 彼らは初めての家を買うために30年の ___ ローンを組んだ。
questions.explanationJa: 「mortgage」は不動産を購入するために組む、長期にわたって返済するローンを意味する。「overdraft」は口座残高以上に使ってしまうことで、異なる種類の借り入れである。
